blinding: Do not communicate individual baseline results to codex2 until coordinator declares L2 frozen.
ground_truth: production_files plus other_production when present; historical first-parent diff, old-side callable mapping from study_localization, language by extension; unsupported/absent/partial/unmapped declarations retained explicitly.
measurement: One default locate on each historical parent, original title plus two newlines plus original issue body; all failures/missing retained. No ranking, term, limit or case tuning.
selection: First15 rows in each stored metadata array with verified bug issue, fix and nonempty production_files, excluding the23 study cases. No filter on native qualification or tests.
